entities.summary: Zernograd is a town and the administrative center of Zernogradsky District in Rostov Oblast, Russia, located 71 kilometers (44 mi) southeast of Rostov-on-Don, the administrative center of the oblast. Population: 26,842 (2010 census); 28,840 (2002 census); 26,097 (1989 Soviet census).
